  rw [HurwitzZeta.hurwitzZeta_def]
  have h : ∑ (n : ℕ) in Finset.range (k + 1), ↑x^n / (↑n + ↑k + 1) = -1 / (↑k + 1) * Polynomial.eval (↑x) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) (Polynomial.bernoulli (k + 1))) :=
    by
